from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) >= 2:
        dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
        dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
        if dr > 0 and dc > 0 and all((b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) == (dr, dc) for a, b in zip(points, points[1:])):
            r, c = points[-1]
            r += dr
            c += dc
            while r < len(out) and c < len(out[0]):
                if out[r][c] == 0:
                    out[r][c] = 2
                r += dr
                c += dc
    return out
'''
file=programs/'task-20f93ffb.py'
file.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(file), 'exec'))

def grid(points):
    g=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
    for r,c in points: g[r][c]=1
    return g
# Demo 1 expected existing ones followed by 2 at interval 2
x1=grid([(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)])
y1=transform(x1)
expected1=[(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]
expected2=[(7,7),(9,9),(11,11),(13,13)]
assert all(y1[r][c]==1 for r,c in expected1)
assert [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(y1) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]==expected2
# Demo 2
x2=grid([(0,0),(4,4),(8,8)])
y2=transform(x2)
assert [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(y2) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]==[(12,12)]
test=grid([(0,0),(3,3),(6,6)])
out=transform(test)
print('demo checks passed; test output:')
for row in out: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
